title: Early-Closure Requests on Credit Builder Accounts
content:
Early closure is the borrower's own decision over their savings, so a representative registers the request and the borrower confirms it; a Credit Builder account is never closed early on a representative's say-so.

## Guidance

1. The account closes early only when the borrower confirms a pending early-closure request no later than the closure confirmation days after the request date (14 calendar days on every Credit Builder Accounts plan). The confirmation period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the request date, and a confirmation on the last day is in time.
2. A request names where the remaining savings go: a verified linked checking account of the borrower, or a mailed check when none is named.
3. Only 1 early-closure request may be pending on an account; a borrower who changes their mind withdraws it.
4. A confirmed early closure closes the account on the confirmation date, and closing interest is counted through that date.

The request date (the date the request was registered) and the request's status (pending confirmation, confirmed or withdrawn) are read from the account's early-closure request record.

## Confirmation window (hypothetical dates)

| Request date | Last day of the confirmation period | Confirmation date | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 June | 17 June | 17 June | in time; the account closes on 17 June |
| 3 June | 17 June | 18 June | too late; the request has lapsed |
| 25 February (non-leap year) | 11 March | 11 March | in time |

## Points of judgement

- While one request is pending confirmation on an account, no second request can be pending on it.
- Where the request names no verified linked checking account, the remaining savings go by mailed check.
